spec_ref: 05-model-router/spec.md §14 (RC-1) — the registry is the user's connect list; supersedes §1.2
invariants: no secret value is ever stored: auth.key_env names an environment variable and nothing else (RC-1.2)
locus and privacy_class are USER DECLARATIONS, not measurements; the decision log marks them declared (RC-1.3)
price.source=unknown means the connection cannot be ranked by cost; the router must never invent a price (RC-1.4)
an active connection is a routing target only while it is not marked unhealthy by the circuit breaker
capability_key includes the mode when a provider serves the same model id in more than one mode, so a chat measurement is never credited to a reasoning connection
